name: Test scenes
author: DecompRecomp
description: Hold L1 and confirm Option on the title menu: a duel with Simon Muran on the standard field opens with chosen monsters already face up. The cards are the settings p1-p5 (yours, left to right) and o1-o5 (the opponent's), 0 for an empty zone; MEMORIES_MOD_TEST_SCENES_P1 ... _O5 set them for one run. The defaults leave a gap between monsters (zones 1, 3, 5 and 6, 8, 10).
